Name: ConnectSwitch
Description: Connect or disconnect both configured ports

Name: Refresh
Description: Refresh DeviceMap, FrameRule, and referenced Register Maps while disconnected

Name: State
Description: Lifecycle state; CAPL output displayed read-only on Panel

Name: LastResult
Description: Last completed lifecycle result; CAPL output displayed read-only on Panel

Name: ConfigurationValid
Description: CSV validation state; CAPL output displayed read-only on Panel

Name: ConnectedLed
Description: Actual connected state; 1 only when State is Connected

Name: BusyLed
Description: Lifecycle busy state; 1 while Refreshing Connecting or Disconnecting

Name: ErrorLed
Description: Lifecycle error state; 1 only when State is Error

Name: StateText
Description: Readable lifecycle state; CAPL output displayed read-only on Panel

Name: Data
Description: Panel capacity: 122 register values in 32-bit elements
